elsewhere.note: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the wood.
Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.
In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel…
Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.
